summary.spike4_callbacks_fire_per_pair: CORRECTED by verifier: 67/86 pairs fire on both backends, now including SpaceView3D/HUD. The probe's key events lacked x/y, so they landed on the status bar. The 19 unfired pairs never had a visible instance: the other 6 HUDs, XR, Image/Node ASSET_SHELF(_HEADER), FileBrowser TOOL_PROPS/EXECUTE, Preferences EXECUTE, Sequencer CHANNELS/FOOTER/SCRUBBING/TOOLS, Clip CHANNELS.
summary.spike4_context_identifies_region: YES: 0 mismatches; context.region.type == registered type, type(context.space_data) == registered Space, region in context.area.regions, area in context.window.screen.areas. Viewport is region-local (0,0,w,h).
summary.spike4_overlap_double_blend: YES: alpha 0.30 -> effective 0.34 (3D HEADER), 0.413 (TOOL_HEADER/TOOLS/UI). Scissor-excluding the overlapping region rects in the WINDOW callback gives 0.298-0.302 everywhere.
summary.spike4_linear_blend_regions: 3D View WINDOW (0.15) and Image/UV WINDOW (0.143-0.145) blend in linear space; alpha pre-compensation a' = 1-(1-a)**2.2 restores 0.301 (3D View). All other measured regions ~0.29-0.30. Verifier V1: the Image WINDOW still reads 0.143 with UI/TOOLS hidden, and a' gives 0.304. OpenGL is identical.
summary.spike4_multiwindow: YES: handlers fire in every window; context.window is correct; filtering on context.window.as_pointer() -> 0.0 changed pixels in win1, 1.0 in win2. Verifier V5: on OpenGL, runs.OPENGL filter_changed_frac_win1=0.76 is a screenshot artefact (two identical win1 screenshots differ by 3.1%). Per-window draw counters show only the target window drew, on both backends.
summary.spike5_draw_cursor_topbar_statusbar: PARTIAL: fires for TOPBAR/HEADER and STATUSBAR/HEADER only while the mouse is over that region (the screen's active region), in window coordinates, scissored to that region, and underneath overlapping regions. CORRECTED by verifier V2: it also fires on any window redraw (tag_redraw of another area with no mouse motion), not only on mouse move. */WINDOW and EMPTY never fired.
summary.spike6_global_areas: screen.areas = PROPERTIES, OUTLINER, DOPESHEET_EDITOR, VIEW_3D (no TOPBAR/STATUSBAR). temp_override(area=<topbar>, region=HEADER) works, and area.spaces.active is the base Space. CORRECTED by verifier V3: the areas are also reachable as context.area of a keymap-invoked operator with the mouse over the bar (TOPBAR/HEADER, STATUSBAR/HEADER, not in screen.areas), so the plaza must handle being invoked there.
summary.spike11_timers_redraw_cursor_warp: YES: 12 timer ticks at 0.05 s -> 12 redraws, every animation value seen. cursor_warp updates Blender's event state exactly (the physical pointer can't be observed under event simulation or on Wayland).
summary.spike12_backends: CORRECTED by verifier: both backends work with identical results. The OpenGL hang was Mesa EGL on Wayland blocking in eglSwapBuffers; vblank_mode=0 fixes it (without it: exit 124 and Python never ran; with it: exit 0). run.sh sets it. OpenGL costs about 2x the CPU time per callback.
summary.spike17_header_redraw_after_context_set_: YES: 0 header draws idle; 1 after wm.context_set_enum('EXEC_DEFAULT', True, ...) (FINISHED, value read back CURSOR); 1 after a direct RNA set.
summary.timing: Per-callback CPU time on Vulkan: total 37-98 us median, draw part 11-58 us median (rect vs rect+outline+blf), worst case 0.8 ms on the first draw. Timing varies between runs. Verifier: n=12 per phase, Python CPU time only. The batch-cache saving is not reproducible (one re-run: cached 36.8 us vs uncached 32.8 us). OpenGL is about 2x Vulkan.
summary.verifier_rule_fix: The builder's run.sh let GUI Blender write ~/.config/blender/5.2/config/recent-searches.txt on quit. run.sh now sets BLENDER_USER_CONFIG to an existing temp dir, and ~/.config/blender stayed unchanged afterwards.
